customers_say: Customers find the smart door lock to be of excellent quality, with smooth installation that doesn't damage the door. Moreover, the functionality works as expected with no issues, and the app is user-friendly with clear instructions. They appreciate the multiple unlock options and advanced security features that completely transform home security management. Additionally, the appearance receives positive feedback, with one customer noting it looks cool.
